title: Beyond Deep Ensembles: A Large-Scale Evaluation of Bayesian Deep Learning under Distribution Shift
reasoning: The paper evaluates models on the CIVILCOMMENTS-WILDS dataset, which is a binary text classification task focused on identifying toxic comments. The dataset groups comments based on whether they mention specific demographic groups (e.g., LGBTQ or Muslim identities), and models are evaluated based on their performance on the group with the lowest accuracy. This directly addresses fairness and potential bias against demographic groups, which falls under ethical considerations in AI beyond a general statement of ethical implications.
